title: Ukrainian (Illustrations of the IPA). Journal of the International Phonetic Association 47(3), 2017, 349–357
author: Bernd Pompino-Marschall, Elena Steriopolo, Marzena Żygis
publisher: International Phonetic Association / Cambridge University Press (open-access copy on edoc-Server, Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin)
usedFor: the main phonetic description behind the pronunciation pages: the six vowels, hard and soft consonants, г, в, й and щ, voicing, and free, moving stress.
notes: DOI 10.1017/S0025100316000372, first published online 4 November 2016. Read as text extracted from the PDF; the IPA symbols did not survive extraction, so no IPA is reproduced on the site from this source. The description is based on one speaker from Bukovina educated in Kyiv; the authors note contradictory results in the literature on half-palatalized consonants, the vowel и and geminates. It describes Ukrainian sounds, not English comparisons.
